summary: Hosted API: increased request timeouts during peak (eu-west)
description:
Issue summary:
- Multiple customers (starting with HelioSearch) reporting chat requests timing out in eu-west.

Impact:
- Requests hang and then fail with client timeout (~60s).
- Support dashboard shows increased p99 latency and increased timeout rate.

Primary symptom: Request timeouts
Deployment offering: Hosted API

Environment:
- prod eu-west

What we know:
- Queue depth increased rapidly at 09:10 UTC.
- Autoscaler did not add capacity due to quota guardrail.

Comms:
- Coordinating in #support and #incidents.
comments: Vanessa Ortiz (2026-03-07): Declaring P0 escalation; customers blocked. Starting incident bridge.
Incident Bot (2026-03-07): Incident declared: INC-2026-03-07-eu-west-timeouts (status: investigating)
Elliot Price (2026-03-07): Root cause appears to be misconfigured GPU quota cap for eu-west shared pool after recent capacity move.
Elliot Price (2026-03-07): Raised quota cap + restarted autoscaler loop; queue depth recovering.
Vanessa Ortiz (2026-03-08): Customer confirms timeouts resolved. Closing.
